title: Sandbox Code Execution Roadmap
goal: Let Odysseus execute code, tests and small build tasks inside disposable Podman sandboxes with scoped mounts, resource limits and auditable artifacts.

slice_queue.goal: Define safe templates for Python, Node, browser, document conversion and static-analysis jobs.
Classify sandbox outputs into logs, screenshots, reports and generated files with redaction and retention policy.
Enforce CPU, memory, timeout, pids, filesystem and network constraints before job dispatch.
Attach sandbox results to the agent result observer with exit code, evidence summary and next-action recommendation.

slice_queue.evidence: Debian live Podman smoke ran a disposable sandbox container with --network none, 512m memory, 0.5 CPUs, pids-limit 128, no-new-privileges and validated the python_pytest template guard.
slice_queue.goal: Run one Python and one Node disposable sandbox job on Debian and verify artifacts are redacted.

done_definition: Agents cannot execute arbitrary host commands by default.
Every sandbox job has explicit limits and a correlation id.
Network access is opt-in per job.
Artifacts are redacted and retained under policy.
Operator can understand what was run and why.
